title: The Illusion of Knowledge
summary:
What will be the marginal propensity to consume? That reminded me to
include a Chesterton quote that I used in Risk Revisited Again, June 2015. Chair, Jerome Powell, seems to agree that providing estimates of where the Fed sees interest rates,
economic growth and inflation at different points in the future should be junked.
